title: Observed runtime call overlay S2
goal: Add run-bound observed call evidence from tests or traces as a separate overlay that never upgrades static completeness claims.

acceptance.assertion: Every S2 relation is bound to one command, environment, run identity and source revision.
Observed edges remain distinct from static S1 and candidate S0 relations.
Absence from a trace does not establish dead code or unreachable behavior.

metadata.source_request: User requested all Symbol Call Graph work to be registered and implemented.

lease_scope_migration.rationale: The runtime-overlay work reads only its exact Bureau task, shared initiative truth and current plan; trace production and overlay code remain in Lenskit.
does_not_establish: safe mutation of terminal historical tasks

metadata.outcome: RepoGround records command-bound observed runtime calls as an explicit S2 overlay, keeps them separate from S1/S0 static relations, and encodes that missing trace observations establish neither dead code nor unreachability.
validation: GitHub PR #1134 merged exact head fa8ee5ce63ddd32b981f3678f76eff524c7b90e7 into merge commit 15c8ed913ae8d02cb72ae93f4d5c2bf618f29a76; the merge commit is an ancestor of RepoGround main.

GitHub reported every status check successful, including pytest-full, browser-tests, release-candidate, Ruff, CodeQL, contracts validation, parity, task-index and AI-context guards; the PR has zero review threads.
Current RepoGround main f49a978e161797fb6a1740f5c9b723bb2ae054af passed merger/repoground/tests/test_observed_call_overlay.py with 46 tests and targeted Ruff checks for all changed Python modules.
The implementation diff served by GitHub is bound to SHA-256 8bba1849282d7ae7eebacd64f31f78145bd334cea6e7688a44b9bbbb62793cbb.

verified_acceptance.rpu-v1-t026-run-binding: PASS: each S2 relation is tied to one observation_run_id, command, environment, run fingerprint and Git source revision; unresolved source identity is rejected.
verified_acceptance.rpu-v1-t026-separation: PASS: S2 remains a separate overlay; validators reject static S0/S1 fields in the overlay and reject S2 evidence in the static graph. Correspondence annotation never upgrades static evidence.
verified_acceptance.rpu-v1-t026-nonclaims: PASS: absence_semantics and required does_not_establish values explicitly forbid dead-code, unreachability, coverage-sufficiency and static-upgrade conclusions from an unobserved edge.
